content.short: MoveBit builds standards and delivers security audits for the Move ecosystem.
content.description: MoveBit, part of BitsLab, is a dedicated security team focused on the Move ecosystem. It develops security standards and delivers thorough audits to strengthen Move-based projects from design through deployment. As a security partner to Sui, Aptos, and Movement, MoveBit collaborates with leading teams to improve risk assessment, code quality, and overall resilience across the ecosystem. The team has audited nine of the top ten TVL projects in the Sui ecosystem, reflecting proven expertise in securing high-value deployments and critical infrastructure.
